reference.limits: response size controlled by limit (1-100, no cursor/offset); Token is a query parameter and 'is for your use only … do not share it, commit it to version control, or expose it in client-side code'; the docs carry a 'Terms of Use — Mandatory Link Attribution' section (link back to web3.career required); response size controlled by limit (1-100, no cursor/offset); 'silent filter failures' documented (unknown filter values return unfiltered results). fields.help: Web3.career API token from https://web3.career/web3-jobs-api ('Your token is for your use only … Do not share it').

adapter.rate_note: Rate limited ('429 responses when exceeded'); the best-practices page suggests caching responses for 5 minutes. One request every five seconds.
adapter.terms: Mandatory link attribution: link to each job with its apply_url as a follow link and do not modify apply_url (https://docs.bondex.app/api-reference/web3-career-jobs-api).

search.note: GET /api/v1?token=&tag=&limit= (1–100, no offset or cursor, so page is ignored). tag must be one exact slug from the documented list (solidity, rust, backend, defi, …) — 'Invalid tags silently return empty results' — so pass a tag as query. The body is a mixed array '[string, string, Job[]]' ('typically at index 2'), mapped from element 2. country wants a slug (united-states), not ISO, and remote only accepts 'true', so neither is sent. url is apply_url (required attribution link); salary is free text (raw).

not_offered.me: No account endpoint; the token is a query parameter only.
not_offered.get_posting: Single endpoint (/v1); no per-id lookup is documented.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint; apply_url sends the applicant to the posting.
